MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 169

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

9. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 7
   C. 4
   D. 5

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

15. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
